searchText: The EF is commissioning security audits of three smart contacts that will be used by EIPs included in Pectra. Deadline for proposals is October 11. More details in the RFP: https://github.com/ethereum/requests-for-proposals/blob/master/open-rfps/pectra-system-contracts-audit.md
